== Overview ==

'''NotificationProtocol''' is a simple protocol that provides developers a way to send clients notifications.

== Methods ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Method ID !! Name
|-
| 1 || [[#ProcessNotificationEvent]]
|}

=== ProcessNotificationEvent ===

Used by the server to send a client a notification.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#NotificationEvent]] || oEvent || Notification data
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

== Classes ==

=== NotificationEvent ===

This class holds the data about a given notification. The meaning of the fields changes based on the context the notification is sent in, the notification type, etc.

== Notification Types ==

Notification types are a combined value made up of a [[#Notification Categories|category]] and a [[#Notification Subtypes|subtype]]. The final type sent in notifications is calculated using <code>(category * 1000) + subtype</code>. Most categories do not have subtypes, and only have one function.

== Notifications ==

=== 2000 ===

Sent to all participants of the [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] who are ''not'' the owner when a session is launched.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user launched the session
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_strParam || Session URL from the call
|}

=== 3001 ===

Sent to the owner of a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when a new participant joins.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource ||The user triggered the join. Usually the new participant
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the new participant
|-
| m_strParam || Message the joiner sent when joining
|-
| m_uiParam3 || Number of participants
|}

=== 3002 ===

Sent to the owner of a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when a participant calls [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol#CancelParticipation|MatchMakingProtocol#CancelParticipation]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The caller
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the caller
|-
| m_strParam || Message the caller sent when cancelling
|}

=== 3007 ===

Sent to the owner of a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when a participant disconnects without first leaving the [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The disconnected user
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the disconnected user
|-
| m_strParam || Message
|}

=== 3008 ===

Sent to the owner of a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when a participant intentionally ends their participation in the [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The leaving user
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the leaving user
|-
| m_strParam || Message
|}

=== 4000 ===

Sent to all participants in a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when the owner changes.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The previous owner
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the new owner
|-
| m_strParam || Timestamp in microseconds
|-
| m_uiParam2 || Unknown. In Splatoon this is sometimes 0, sometimes 1
|}

=== 109000 ===

Sent to all participants in a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when the [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] is deleted.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] owner
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|}

=== 110000 ===

Sent to all participants in a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] when the host changes.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|}

=== 115000 ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user that made the service item request
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Request ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || Unknown
|}

=== 116000 ===

Sent to all participants in a round when the round begins.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user who started the round
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Round ID
|}

=== 117000 ===

Sent to all participants in a round when the first round report is recieved.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user who started the round
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Round ID
|}

=== 118000 ===

Sent to all participants in a round has been summarized.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_uiParam1 || Round ID
|}

=== 120000 ===

Sent to all participants in a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#MatchmakeSession|MatchmakeSession]] when the system password has been set.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user who set the password
|-
| m_strParam || Password
|}

=== 121000 ===

Sent to all participants in a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#MatchmakeSession|MatchmakeSession]] when the system password has been cleared.

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user who cleared the password
|}

=== 122000 ===

Sent to the target user who is being added to a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Field !! Value
|-
| m_pidSource || The user who added the target
|-
| m_uiParam1 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID
|-
| m_uiParam2 || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the target
|-
| m_strParam || Join message
|}

=== 128000 ===

Triggered by [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/SubscriberProtocol|SubscriberProtocol#UpdateUserStatus]]?
